overworld21.note: Global49MapEnv.step() selects the first outgoing edge whose direction is in ('climb_up/advance', 'dungeon_enter'). Both Overworld 21 entrances share action 9, so the second entrance (volcano1) cannot be deliberately chosen.

MapEnv.obs_layout: 7x7 window x {walkable, visited} = 98 features + 4 scalars (x/32, y/32, coverage, steps_remaining_ratio)
MapEnv.notes: Docstring says 53 features and mentions a water channel, but the code emits 102 features and only walkability+visited channels. No directional affordance, water, terrain or portal information in the observation.

Global49MapEnv.obs_layout: 49 current-map one-hot + 49 target-map one-hot + 2 position + 1 local coverage + 49 map visit counts + 49 steps-since-visit + 5 recent-map history = 204
Global49MapEnv.notes: Local actions 0-4 each run a full BFS route to a sector waypoint in one macro-step. Actions 5-10 are map-transition macros. Not tile-by-tile movement.

training_settings.start_map_sampling: overworld1 every 4th episode, otherwise uniform random over 49 maps
training_settings.target_map_sampling: uniform random map different from the start map
training_settings.success_condition: current_map == target_map (no target coordinate, region or exploration requirement)
training_settings.termination: done when target map entered or macro_steps >= max_macro_steps
training_settings.checkpoint_selection: saves global_49map_dqn_best.pt whenever episode reward > best_reward OR maps_visited > best_maps_visited; updates only the improved best value, then loads that checkpoint to export global_49map_weights.json
training_settings.timeout_label: No explicit timeout column. A timeout is inferable only as target_reached == 0 and steps == max_macro_steps.

recorder.finding: Array-form 'm' events carry map/name data but no x/y. RecorderParser sets x=y=0 and records transitions with (0,0). This session is NOT a valid tile-level human trajectory dataset and must not be treated as one.

provenance.caveat: The current workspace metadata claims 8000 episodes and the log contains 8000 rows. This differs from the earlier snapshot described in the plan (episodes: 5). The files cannot be cryptographically proven to be the exact run shown in any external screenshot; do not claim they are the 6500-episode screenshot run. All existing artifacts were left untouched.

log_trend.per_distance_bucket: NOT AVAILABLE: the CSV records no start map or target map, so the historical run cannot be grouped by target-distance bucket.

legacy_feasibility.caveat: Under legacy macro semantics one map transition costs one macro-step and the transition does not require reaching a portal, so every pair (max 14 hops) fits in 20 macro-steps. This says nothing about physical tile-level feasibility.
